grounding: Retained workspace snippets establish plain-language MEASUREMENT FREQUENCY obligations for named parameters on permits NM0020583, NM0000116, and NM0028762 (e.g., documents/farmington/final_permit.txt lines 56–86: pH Five/Week, TRC Daily, TDS 1/Week; documents/gcc/final_permit.txt lines 57–74: pH and Flow 1/Day, TSS 1/Week; documents/aztec/final_permit.txt lines 72–82: Flow 2/Week, TRC 1/Day, TDS 1/Quarter). sources/permit_limits.csv confirms eight distinct LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE values with no definition column. No retained snippet prints any opaque code token (05/WK, 01/07, 01/01, 99/99, 09/99, etc.) or states an NN/PP encoding rule. Candidate code meanings in the packet are tied to permit+parameter crosswalk between CSV rows and permit tables, which the packet itself flags as insufficient to serve as a code legend.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE values encode count-over-period (NN/PP), whether sentinel codes 99/99 and 09/99 mean continuous monitoring and conditional WET retest respectively, whether the crosswalk generalizes beyond the three exemplified permits and eight observed values, and how to reconcile contradictory flow-frequency wording (Continuous + 99/99 in final permit vs five-times-per-week narrative in documents/farmington/statement_of_basis.txt line 642).
